title: Pre-flight refuses a macOS stage whose build products or artefact path git does not ignore
body:
The release cut's macOS stage (ST0011/05) and its local gates run at once in one working tree at the release commit. Each reads the tree as clean: app-sign's own checks at the release commit, the gates' changed-path check, and each seal's `commit at close:` line. A path either one leaves that git does not ignore (a product of `macos.build`, or the stage's artefact `path`) fails the other's check, and the failure is blamed on the leg that read it, not the one that wrote it. docs/configuration.md says that both must be ignored by git; nothing checks it.

Wanted: the cut's pre-flight refuses a declared macOS stage whose artefact path, or whose `macos.build` output where it can be known, git does not ignore (`git check-ignore`), naming the path, before anything is stamped.

When: after the release that ships ST0011 (0.1.19), and before the first project adopts the macOS stage. Raised by the hook-in unit's critic review (r1, a note outside the rule library), and ruled an issue rather than unit work by vc on 2026-11-01.
